Name: Nintendo Switch Controls for PC
Author: MalGal13
Description:
I found the source code at https://github.com/briankendall/stardew-switch-controls (not a coder, not tryna plagarize either), but this only swapped A and B buttons, which wasn't the issue for me. I changed A and B to X and Y respectively then had my game designer friend walk me through how to turn that code into the normal mod files. I tested it myself on the most up to date (as of January 29, 2026) stardew and SMAPI versions.

Note: I said requires SMAPI and content patcher, but I actually have no idea. I'm not a crazy modder guys, I just swapped two letters in the code.

No extra versions are coming if it stops working, idk guys

Manifest.Name: SwitchControls
Manifest.Description: Changes the controls to work like on the Nintendo Switch
